patterns.md: Work through collaboration patterns first, then use retry, circuit breaking and compensation to recover from failures.
patterns/repository.md: Choose the data source the UI observes and define how refresh failures reach the caller.
patterns/adapter.md: Translate another component’s input and output into the contract your app owns.
patterns/factory.md: Give construction its own boundary when callers need different inputs or owners.
patterns/builder.md: Use a builder when staged configuration improves the call site and publish a stable result.
patterns/strategy.md: Select an algorithm through a shared contract and make the selection rules explicit.
patterns/decorator.md: Add behavior at a wrapper boundary and check what the order changes.
patterns/observer.md: Choose what a collector should see when it arrives late or leaves before handling an update.
patterns/state.md: Make valid screen states explicit and separate transitions from effect execution.
patterns/command.md: Make an operation survive interruption with saved inputs and a stable identity.
patterns/retry.md: Choose which failures may be retried and preserve identity across every attempt.
patterns/circuit-breaker.md: Read the three admission states and decide what a recovery probe proves.
patterns/saga.md: Record the outcome of each step and compensate the work that actually completed.
